title: Good Vibrations
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Good Vibrations”, a luxury 7-bed, 6.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Elevator & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Resort Style Pool and spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Gulf Views - Elevator - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included Good Vibrations stands as an exquisite, recently constructed modern beach cottage, gracefully situated within the heart of one of 30A’s original communities. Seagrove, an emblematic beach town, harmoniously combines extensive shores of pristine, sugar-white sands with the charming ambiance of Old Florida. Its defining feature is its unparalleled natural beauty, where beach cottage homes grace the rolling dunes adorned with sea oats, while pelicans serenely soar above. The Eastern Lake area is simply incomparable, offering an array of activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. Additionally, the nearby Timpoochee Trail provides easy access for leisurely bicycle rides through the neighboring 30A communities. This modern oasis exudes luxury and comfort with its pristine design, incorporating warm wood tones and textures that beautifully anchor its expansive, airy spaces. Custom light fixtures add a touch of sophistication, enhancing the open-concept layout. The heart of the home, a well-appointed chef’s kitchen, boasts a 6-burner gas range, a Sub-Zero fridge, elegant marble countertops, and a generously sized island with seating. The dining area, perfect for gatherings, accommodates up to 10 guests, creating a seamless flow from the kitchen. The main living area is adorned with plush, inviting furniture and features a modern fireplace, creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxation and gatherings. Practicality meets luxury in the laundry room, which offers the convenience of double washer and dryer sets. The opulence of this stunning property extends to its private quarters. The spacious and elegantly designed king bedroom offers the perfect retreat after a day of beachside bliss and features a beautifully appointed bathroom equipped with a shower, offering both style and comfort to guests. Whether it’s the serene ambiance, high-end finishes, or the attention to detail, every aspect of this luxury property is designed to provide an unparalleled experience for its fortunate occupants. Ascending to the second level of this extraordinary abode, you’ll discover an inviting family area adorned with plush, comfortable furniture. This space seamlessly extends to the expansive deck, offering picturesque views of the pool and a perfect setting for al fresco dining and relaxation. For added convenience, a half bathroom is thoughtfully located off the living area, ensuring that every moment here is comfortable and carefree. Each bedroom on this level is thoroughly furnished with luxurious amenities, ensuring a restful night’s sleep. Guests will find a King Bedroom, providing a serene haven for guests. This bedroom boasts a private bathroom with a luxurious tub and shower combination, offering a soothing retreat after a day of beach adventures. Additionally, the master King Bedroom on this level is a true highlight, featuring its private bathroom with a spacious shower. These well-appointed bedrooms offer both comfort and privacy, ensuring a restful and rejuvenating stay for all fortunate enough to call this property home during their stay. Move upward to the third level, where you can start your day with a cup of freshly brewed coffee or unwind with a glass of wine while savoring the breathtaking Gulf views from the pool facing deck. This serene outdoor space provides the perfect vantage point for enjoying the tranquil mornings and mesmerizing sunsets. As an added touch of comfort and convenience, the remaining bedrooms provide a range of sleeping options, accommodating various guest preferences. One of the King Bedrooms on this floor provides a private retreat, featuring its luxurious bathroom with a spa shower, offering a rejuvenating spa-like experience. Another King Bedroom offers spacious comfort and shares a stylish bathroom with a spa shower. Additionally, a Twin-over-Twin Bunk Room and a Twin-over-Queen Bunk Room provide flexible sleeping options, perfect for families or larger groups. Both bunk rooms share a well-appointed bathroom with a shower, while the Twin-over-Queen Bunk Room enjoys the added luxury of its private bathroom with a tub and shower combination. This level is designed to provide the utmost comfort and convenience for all guests, ensuring a truly memorable stay in this luxurious property. Good Vibrations epitomizes the pinnacle of coastal living. With its meticulously designed interior spaces, captivating pool-facing decks with Gulf views, and an array of thoughtfully appointed bedrooms and bathrooms, it offers an unparalleled retreat for discerning travelers. Whether you’re savoring your morning coffee while taking in the stunning sunrise or toasting to the day’s end with a glass of wine while watching the sun dip below the horizon, this home provides the perfect backdrop for unforgettable moments. Whether you’re seeking relaxation, adventure, or both, this property promises an exceptional stay, where comfort, style, and natural beauty converge to create lasting memories. Discover the ultimate blend of luxury and coastal charm in this exquisite vacation oasis Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom - Shared Bathroom with shower only - King Bedroom , Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub combo Second Floor - Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only Half Bathroom Third Floor - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only - King Bedroom, Shared Bathroom w/ Shower Only - Twin over Twin Bunk Room, Shared Bathroom w/ Shower Only - 2 Twin over Queen Bunk Room, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub combo
